description: Jade Note gives ChatGPT secure access to your personal notes as a persistent memory layer. Through MCP, ChatGPT can search notes by keyword or meaning, read category context, create and append notes, suggest links, and keep knowledge organized. OAuth authentication, per-category access controls, change previews, version history, and rollback make AI-assisted memory safe and transparent while keeping the same Markdown notes editable in the Jade Note web app.
